metadata.title: COSU Print / Scan Release Station SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Print and Scan Release Stations as constrained endpoint execution environments supporting secure document release workflows.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to authentication, authorization, and release of print and scan jobs at managed multifunction devices (MFDs), with no general-purpose computing capability.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Print / Scan Release Stations inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for secure print and scan job release.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved print management and scan release applications.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Users authenticate transiently (e.g., badge, PIN, or federated identity) for job release without persistent local sessions.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Print / Scan Release Stations are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Stations are centrally enrolled, configured, monitored, and updated.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for secure communication with print services and management platforms, not for data entitlement.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables shell access, removable media, local storage, and non-release applications.

props.name: session-isolation
props.remarks: Each authentication session is isolated and fully cleared after job release or timeout.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved print management systems, directory services, PKI services, and device management endpoints.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Print and scan content must not be stored locally on the release station.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Print / Scan Release Stations may participate in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1 and 2 only.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: A secure transaction device does not imply trust as a general workstation or eligibility for higher-classification data.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Release Stations must prioritize uptime and rapid recovery to support institutional printing and scanning services.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Station health, authentication events, configuration drift, and misuse attempts are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Print / Scan Release Stations support automated reset, periodic reimage, and auditable retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Print / Scan Release Stations implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on transactional integrity, identity binding for release operations, and data minimization.

roles.title: Print Services Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, availability, and day-to-day operation of Print / Scan Release Stations.

roles.title: Information Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Approves data classification scope, print policies, and exception handling.

control-implementation.remarks: Print / Scan Release Station implementations are OS- and vendor-specific (dedicated appliances, embedded OS, or hardened endpoints) and are maintained as controlled, versioned configuration baselines.
